title: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST…
description: DreameHome cloud API versions before 2026-10-14 have an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /dreame-user-iot/token/rtc2 endpoint. Authenticated attackers can exploit this flaw by supplying another user's device DID and owner UID to obtain an Agora RTC token without verifying device ownership. This allows attackers to join the live-video channel of the targeted device and publish video under that device's identity.
